# Isaiah Chapter 49 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 26 verses]*

*Second Servant Song; called from womb; light to nations; mother's love surpassed; engraved on palms*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 49 (The Servant's Mission) addresses second servant song; called from womb; light to nations; mother's love surpassed; engraved on palms. The key verse — "Can a woman forget her nursing child? Even these may forget, yet I will not forget you" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to Second Isaiah (chs. 40-55), focused on comfort, restoration, and the servant figure.
